## Modules

- [Membrane.TimestampQueue](https://membrane-timestamp-queue.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.TimestampQueue.md): Implementation of a queue, that accepts:
 - Membrane buffers
 - events
 - stream formats
 - end of streams
from various pads. Items in queue are sorted according to their timestamps.
